apple_source: optimize_qwen3_6_27b_1xh100_open (vLLM 0.20.1, Qwen3.6-27B, 1xH100); Apple recipe kept, workload set moved to the high-concurrency regime where stock vLLM has headroom on a 4090

calibration_host: RTX 5090 (sm_120, 32607 MiB, also drives the desktop, about 950 MiB), AMD Ryzen 9 3950X. Copy of qwen35_4b_1x4090_hc with only host fields changed, plus the locked --gpu-memory-utilization 0.70 instead of 0.85: at 0.85 the reference, and at 0.80 the pristine cache build, crossed the 31,000 MiB kill line. 0.70 x 32.6 GB is about 22.8 GB, close to the 4090 budget 0.85 x 24 GB, about 20.9 GB.
